meta.title: Catering Company in Riyadh | Plum Catering
meta.description: Plum Catering provides corporate catering, celebration and event catering, and wholesale bakery supply from its central kitchen in Riyadh. Request a quote.

hero.h1: Catering Services in Riyadh for Businesses and Celebrations
hero.lead: From daily corporate dining to weddings and private occasions, Plum prepares every menu in its own central kitchen and delivers it with care, consistency and attention to detail.

about.body: Plum Catering is a Riyadh-based catering and food-industry brand serving organisations, families and foodservice businesses. Our work brings together carefully planned menus, a professional central kitchen and dependable service teams, so that every client receives food prepared to the same standard whether it is a meeting lunch, a large celebration or a recurring bakery order. We take time to understand each brief, recommend what will work for your guests and setting, and stay in contact from first enquiry to final service.

approach.body: Listen first, plan carefully, prepare with discipline and serve with warmth — the same principles applied to every order.

services.intro: Three established service lines, each with its own specialist team and planning process.

corporates.body: Catering for offices, government entities, healthcare, education and industrial sites — from meeting lunches to recurring meal programmes.

celebrations.body: Weddings, engagements, private occasions and Ramadan gatherings, with menus and service styles tailored to your event.

b2b.body: Breads, croissants, pastries and cakes supplied to hotels, restaurants, cafés and foodservice operators.

facility.body: A future service line. It is not yet available; details will be announced when it launches.

kitchen.intro: Every Plum menu is prepared in our central kitchen in Riyadh, where planning, preparation and quality checks happen under one roof.

items.body: Documented food-safety procedures guide how ingredients are received, stored, prepared and dispatched.
Dedicated preparation areas and experienced kitchen teams help us deliver consistent results at every scale.

cards.body: Menus prepared from scratch in our own kitchen, with presentation that reflects the occasion.
Clear planning and agreed timelines, so your guests are served when and where you expect.
Preparation, transport and on-site setup coordinated by one team from start to finish.
Menus, service styles and quantities shaped around your brief rather than a fixed package.

cuisine.body: Our menus are planned around each client's occasion, guests and preferences. Explore how this works for {corporates} and for {celebrations}.

work.intro: A selection from recent corporate services, celebrations and our kitchen.

clients.intro: Organisations and families across Riyadh rely on Plum for their catering.

items.q: How do I request a catering quote?
items.a: Select "Request a Quote" on any page and tell us about your event or requirement, including the date, number of guests and location. Our team will review the details and contact you to discuss a proposal.
Plum Catering operates from its central kitchen in Riyadh. Please include your location in your request and we will confirm whether we can serve it.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: Lead times depend on the size of the event, the menu and the season. We recommend contacting us as early as possible, especially for weddings, large corporate events and Ramadan.

items.q: Can you cater for both small and large events?
items.a: Our service teams plan each event according to its guest count and format. Share your expected numbers in the quote form and we will advise on the best service style.

finalCta.body: Share your date, guest count and the kind of experience you have in mind. We will prepare a proposal tailored to you.

meta.title: Corporate Catering in Riyadh | Plum Catering
meta.description: Corporate catering in Riyadh for businesses, government, healthcare, education and industrial sites — events, meal boxes and Ramadan catering. Request a proposal.

hero.lead: Dependable catering for organisations — from boardroom lunches and conferences to recurring meal programmes for hospitals, schools and remote sites.

overview.body: Organisations need catering that runs to schedule, scales with attendance and represents them well in front of guests and staff. Plum plans each corporate service around your audience, location and timing, prepares it in our central kitchen and coordinates delivery and service with your team. Whether you need a one-off event or a recurring programme, you work with one point of contact throughout.

items.body: Meeting lunches, conferences, product launches and staff events, planned around your agenda. We help you choose menus and service styles — from boxed meals to buffets and served dining — that suit the occasion and the number of attendees.
Formal occasions call for careful protocol, presentation and timing. We coordinate closely with your organisers on menu, service sequence and setup so that hospitality runs discreetly and to plan.

Meal services for healthcare settings, planned with your facility team around schedules, service points and any menu requirements you define. Dietary and clinical menu specifications are agreed with your team before service begins.
Catering for industrial and project sites where reliable, consistent meals matter to the workforce. Coverage, delivery schedules and service models are confirmed per site during planning.
Catering for educational institutions, from daily dining to campus events and graduations, planned with your administration around timetables and student numbers.
Individually packed meal boxes for meetings, training days, site visits and events — convenient to distribute, easy to plan and presented with care.
Iftar and Suhoor catering for organisations during the holy month, including staff gatherings and hosted iftars. Because Ramadan is a busy season, we recommend planning early.

kitchen.body: Corporate orders are prepared in our central kitchen in Riyadh under documented food-safety procedures, then dispatched to an agreed schedule.

steps.body: We learn about your organisation, audience, location and schedule.
We propose menus, quantities and service format for your approval.
Your order is prepared in our kitchen and delivery is coordinated with your team.
We serve to plan and follow up to refine recurring services.

items.q: How far in advance should we book corporate catering?
items.a: It depends on the size and format of the service. Contact us as early as possible with your date and expected attendance, and we will confirm what is achievable.

items.q: Can you support recurring daily or weekly catering?
items.a: Yes, we discuss recurring programmes during consultation, including menus, quantities and delivery schedules, and agree them with your team.
Please include your location in your request. Coverage outside Riyadh is confirmed case by case.

items.q: Can we coordinate the menu with our team?
items.a: Yes. Menus are proposed for your approval and can be adjusted to your audience and requirements before confirmation.

finalCta.body: Tell us about your organisation and the service you need. We will prepare a tailored proposal.
